## Checklist

- [ ] One change in this pull request.
- [ ] Tests show it working; a bug fix has a test that fails without the fix.
- [ ] `go vet ./...` is clean.
- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes.
- [ ] `golangci-lint run ./...` reports no issues.
- [ ] Nothing here ties prove itself to one CI system or cloud (those belong in an adapter or `action/`).
